description: Test suite for Vitest configuration and utility functions, including testing of resolveLocalVitestMaxWorkers, resolveLocalVitestScheduling, parseVitestProcessStats, and default config behaviors.

methods.name: resolveDefaultVitestPool
methods.description: Returns the default pool configuration for Vitest, typically 'threads'.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestMaxWorkers
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of local workers based on system specs, environment overrides, and idle stats.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestScheduling
methods.description: Decides scheduling parameters like maxWorkers and fileParallelism based on system load and other active Vitest processes.

methods.name: parseVitestProcessStats
methods.description: Parses process information lines to count other Vitest root and worker processes, excluding the current process.
